subject: Purchase acknowledgement idempotency and discount slab eligibility
messages:
From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@novacare.com>

Cc: Marcus Lee <mlee@novacare.com>; Accounting AP <ap@novacare.com>

Subject: Purchase acknowledgement idempotency and discount slab eligibility

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — NovaCare is keen to move forward. Our procurement team has two quick constraints we need clarified before we generate the PO:

1) PO idempotency / PO-ID mapping: our ERP requires a stable PO header per entity (bill-to) and we need to include the PO ID on every invoice line for automated matching. Can Redwood guarantee the PO-ID will appear as an invoice field and not be split across multiple reference columns?

2) Discount slab question: we have a committed-usage discount tied to a monthly consumption threshold. However, our AP team prefers weekly invoices for operational reasons. If we receive weekly invoices, will discounts still be evaluated on the aggregated monthly consumption (and applied as a credit on the monthly statement), or do discounts require a single consolidated invoice?

Other notes: our standard net terms are Net45. We can provide the PO template (attached). Also copying Marcus (procurement) and AP group.

Attached: NovaCare_PO_Template.xlsx

Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement would like the final answers before we create and route the PO.

Best,
Sara Thompson
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaCare Health

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Purchase acknowledgement idempotency and discount slab eligibility

Hi Sara / Marcus — thanks for the clear note and for sharing the template. Short answers up front, then proposed operational options: 

1) PO-ID on invoices: Yes. We can embed the PO-ID in an explicit invoice field ("PO Number / PO-ID") and also include it in the invoice line memo so your ERP mapping is robust. We'll ensure the field is present on every invoice we issue.

2) Discount evaluation with weekly invoices: We can support weekly invoice delivery while evaluating discounts on the aggregated monthly consumption. Our standard approach for similar enterprise customers is:
- Weekly invoices for AP processing (each invoice contains the PO-ID and usage detail)
- We perform a monthly aggregation for discount slab calculation
- Any discount credits are applied on the monthly reconciliation invoice (credit line) or as a statement-level credit — whichever your AR expects.

Operational asks from our side:
- Please confirm your preferred reconciliation scope: calendar month vs. billing-month aligned to PO start date.
- We need AP email whitelist entries (we typically add your AP address to our payment notification list so automated remittance matches).

Proposed commercial compromise: Redwood will honor the agreed discount slab provided the combined monthly billed usage across the mapped PO(s) meets the threshold. If NovaCare requests per-entity isolation (separate POs per BU), discounts will still aggregate across the parent legal entity if you confirm that in the PO memo (we can map to a parent-entity tag).

Next steps I propose:
1) I will route a small SOW amendment that explicitly states: PO-ID must appear on invoices, weekly invoices are allowed, discount slab is calculated monthly and credited on monthly statement.
2) We (Vanessa + Finance ops) will confirm the AP whitelist and any additional invoice metadata required.
3) If acceptable, please send the completed PO and we can activate onboarding.

Attaching the NovaCare template you sent for reference. Also looping in Vanessa to confirm any finance gating.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Karthik / Sara / Marcus — quick ops note from finance:

Thanks for surfacing this. We can support the flow Karthik outlined with two clarifications from Finance: 

1) Invoice metadata and AP matching: Finance requires the following explicit invoice fields for automated ERP matching: PO Number (single field), Bill-to legal entity (name + tax ID), and Invoice Line PO reference. If those fields are present we can accept weekly invoices and auto-match them.

2) Discount calculation cadence: Discounts will be evaluated on the monthly aggregation of usage tied to the parent legal entity. If NovaCare wants discounts to be applied at BU-level, we need an explicit written mapping that ties BU-level PO numbers to the parent entity for aggregation. Credits for monthly discount reconciliation will show on the month-end invoice as a negative line item referencing the month and PO bucket.

3) AP whitelist: Please have your AP team confirm the exact sending address (we often see "ap@" vs. "payments@" variations). Add ap@novacare.com to our whitelist request and we'll add Redwood's remittance routing.

I've attached our onboarding checklist that lists required fields and a sample invoice export. Priyom, please confirm whether we need a separate SOW amendment or if a short addendum to the existing MSA will suffice for this PO-level language.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
